role: Host type for one-shot, per-install repairs of archived sessions (moved off RRCollector); holds five injected dependencies and runs every repair staggered from RRCollector.runDeferredSessionMigrationsIfNeeded.
types: SessionDataMigrations: class (@MainActor final) — owner of the six one-shot archive migrations, defined across this file and six extension files
state: mem:SessionDataMigrations.archive / healthKit / settingsManager / baselineTracker / reanalysisService (injected lets; instance built per call in RRCollector+Lifecycle.swift:160 and discarded)
toplevel: Class doc states ordering is not a correctness constraint because each migration self-terminates via its own UserDefaults flag (SessionDataMigrations.swift:27-32).

flags.text: Class doc says "the order is not a correctness constraint" but TrainingRecalibration (rescores with an end-anchored context and frozen VO2max) runs before TrimpRepair, which overwrites the same trainingSnapshot/analysisResult.trainingContext/frozenReadiness with a 5 AM-anchored context and VO2max preference and does NOT recompute recoveryScore/scoreBreakdown; the last writer decides what the archive holds, so order changes the stored training snapshot.

docs/FLOWCHART.md §13 says an archived session is frozen except for explicit user actions and additive fill-in merges, but this launch-time chain automatically overwrites recoveryScore/scoreBreakdown/frozenReadiness of historic nights (TrainingRecalibration, InsufficientData, NapRepair, TimeInBed via recomputeScoreOnly) and training snapshots (TrimpRepair); the §13.1 table lists only InsufficientData among them.

units.does: Memberwise initializer storing archive, healthKit, settingsManager, baselineTracker and reanalysisService.

Returns the recovery baseline stats built from stored nights strictly before the session's night (BaselineTracker.recoveryBaselineStats(excludingNightOf:sleepSchedule:)) using the current settings' sleep schedule; nil when fewer than minimumDays prior nights.

flags.text: Same body as ReanalysisService.scoringBaseline(for:) (reads settingsProvider instead of settingsManager).

units.does: Loads every archive index entry's full session (retrieveOrLog, failures logged and dropped) in a detached utility-priority task and returns them in index order.

Runs the six one-shot migrations in fixed order with sleeps of 1.5s,1s,0.5s,0.5s,0.5s,0.5s between them: insufficient-data, training recalibration, TRIMP repair, workout sleep cleanup, nap repair, time-in-bed repair.
units.entry: Awaited by RRCollector.runDeferredSessionMigrationsIfNeeded (RRCollector+Lifecycle.swift:159-166), which AppLaunchTasks.swift:436-440 runs as a background housekeeping job on the launch coordinator. Tests (CollectorMigrationParityTests) call individual migrations, never runAllIfNeeded.

flags.text: sleepQuietly swallows CancellationError (logs and returns), so a cancelled launch task does not stop the chain: all remaining migrations run back-to-back without the intended stagger.

Two migrations rewrite the same training snapshot in one run: runTrainingRecalibrationIfNeeded (anchor = session end, keeps frozen VO2max, rescores) then runTrimpRepairMigrationIfNeeded via ReanalysisService.repairTrainingSnapshots (anchor = 5 AM of end day, applies VO2max override/preference, recomputes frozenReadiness only). Final archived trainingSnapshot comes from the second while recoveryScore/scoreBreakdown come from the first.
